releases.name: v0.6.0 - M5 Ecosystem Milestone Complete
releases.body:
## M5 Ecosystem Milestone — Complete

### Distributors (5 total)
- `pitfall-card` — extract coding pitfalls and fixes
- `issue-draft` — generate structured issue drafts
- `knowledge-card` — capture reusable knowledge (patterns, insights, configs)
- `prd-draft` — extract product requirement document drafts

### Sinks (3 total)
- `file` — local JSON + Markdown output
- `github` — create GitHub Issues (with dry-run mode)
- `notion` — create Notion database pages

### CLI Commands (5 total)
- `loam daemon` — capture daemon with 4 providers
- `loam capture` — manual session capture
- `loam distill` — DAG-based distill pipeline (default mode)
- `loam list` — browse sessions, distill results, and `--scan` reports
- `loam review` — approve/reject workflow with audit trail

### Architecture DAG Blueprint — Phase 0-5
- Typed DAG executor (`@loamlog/pipeline`)
- Asset graph modeling (EvidenceSpan → Signal → AssetCandidate → Decision)
- Transaction-safe state (Mutex + backup recovery)
- Archive metadata index with fast-path queries
- Approval gate + audit records

### Quality Infrastructure
- CI: dual-job workflow (Test & Typecheck + Security Scan)
- Static scan gate: 5 parsers, Top N ranking, rerun comparison
- Multi-tool AI rule files (Cursor, Copilot, Codex)
- Redaction config file support

### Stats
- **160 tests**, 0 fail across **22 packages** (100% test coverage)
- 4 providers, 5 distillers, 3 sinks
- 203 files changed, +36,721 lines

---

Full Changelog: https://github.com/tongsh6/loamlog/compare/v0.5.0...v0.6.0

releases.name: v0.4.0 - Milestone A: Trust Infrastructure
releases.body:
## 🎯 Milestone A: Trust Infrastructure

This release completes Milestone A, establishing the foundational infrastructure for safe and reliable AI log processing.

### ✨ New Capabilities

#### 1. 🛡️ Sanitization Gateway (`@loamlog/sanitizer`)
**Issue**: #26 | **PR**: #39

Log sanitization hard gateway ensuring sensitive data is redacted before AI processing:
- Pattern recognition for API keys, tokens, emails, phone numbers
- Semantic placeholder replacement (e.g., `sk-xxx` → `[API_KEY:OPENAI]`)
- Audit summary with count, type distribution, and risk level
- Support for structured content: JSON, YAML, HTTP, Shell, Markdown

#### 2. ⚡ Triggered Intelligence Pipeline (`@loamlog/trigger`)
**Issue**: #22 | **PR**: #41

Threshold-based, asynchronous, rate-limited intelligence pipeline:
- Multiple trigger types: frequency, severity, semantic, manual
- Async batch processing (configurable batch size and wait time)
- Performance isolation with rate limiting (max pending: 50)
- Degradation and circuit breaker mechanisms
- Decoupled from CLI for maximum reusability

#### 3. 📊 Evaluation Harness (`@loamlog/evaluation-harness`)
**Issue**: #23 | **PR**: #37

Quality evaluation framework for validating distill accuracy:
- Signal extraction accuracy assessment
- Issue draft quality evaluation
- Support for comparing rule/prompt/model versions
- Baseline metrics and comprehensive reporting
- MVP sample dataset included

### 📁 Files Changed
- `packages/sanitizer/` - New package
- `packages/trigger/` - New package  
- `packages/evaluation-harness/` - New package
- `README.md` & `README.zh.md` - Updated documentation
- `AIEF/` - Updated business documentation

### 🔄 Migration
No breaking changes. All new features are additive and backward compatible.

### 📚 Documentation
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/tongsh6/loamlog/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Milestone A Details](https://github.com/tongsh6/loamlog/blob/master/AIEF/context/business/roadmap.md#milestone-a-可信底盘--trust-infrastructure)

### 🚀 What's Next
Milestone B: Protocol Design - MCP Exposure Layer for external AI tool integration.

---

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tongsh6/loamlog/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0

Loamlog v0.3.0 turns the current `develop` line into the next stable release baseline.

## Highlights

### Multi-source provider foundation
- Added Claude Code provider support
- Added provider routing in the CLI capture flow
- Strengthened the path from provider adapters into the unified archive/distill pipeline

### Multi-provider LLM routing
- Added multi-provider LLM routing with fallback support
- Added typed provider/router errors and broader provider coverage
- Improved router tests and configuration handling

### First issue-draft MVP loop
- Added built-in `@loamlog/distiller-issue-draft`
- Added evidence-backed issue-draft generation from a single session
- Added Markdown sibling output in `@loamlog/sink-file` so local drafts now produce both `.json` and `.md`

### CLI and runtime improvements
- Added `loam capture`
- Improved CLI provider wiring and default distill behavior
- Added runtime loading coverage for built-in distillers/sinks

### Documentation and information architecture
- Unified repository documentation under `AIEF/`
- Moved execution plans into `AIEF/plans/`
- Moved lightweight spec docs into `AIEF/openspec/`
- Updated roadmap/current-focus docs to match merged MVP state

## Notes

- Current issue-draft flow is still local-first
- GitHub issue creation is not automated yet
- Discovery/refactor follow-ups remain tracked as later-stage issues

## Verification

- `pnpm run build`
- `pnpm run test`
- `pnpm run typecheck`
